overview: The Umbral Storm Reaches are the birthplace of resonance storms in the Plains. Planar lightning, void winds, and storm-born anomalies converge here.
history: The Reaches formed when the first planar fracture opened, releasing uncontrolled storm energy.
Umbral Vanguard attempted to anchor the region with stabilizers but failed.
Akhevan ritualists learned to channel storm energy for void ascension.
Storm-born entities emerged from lightning fissures, hostile to all factions.
hooks: A mega-storm forms, threatening to sweep across the Plains.
Lightning fissures open new travel routes — and close old ones.
Storm-born entities swarm toward the Dominion Front.
A Vanguard stabilizer tower is struck and destabilizes the region.
